high_level_description: This image is a satellite photograph of the Natanz nuclear facility in Iran, dated June 14, 2025. The photograph is overlaid with labels indicating "Damaged structures" within the facility. The image shows several buildings and structures within the facility, some of which appear to have been damaged, as indicated by the white boxes around them. The text at the top of the image reads: "Damage at the Natanz nuclear facility." It states that CNN obtained satellite imagery from Maxar Technologies, which showed that several areas of the facility were damaged in the strikes.
